name: darkmind
description: Connect Codex to a scoped DarkMind instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped DarkMind tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to DarkMind through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so DarkMind Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DarkMind only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
